file: File:Constitution of the United States - DPLA - 9ca804144bd5965e992ae3528bc3c6a3 (page 1).jpg
title: The Constitution, 1787
institution: U.S. National Archives and Records Administration
reason: The Constitution provides context for Delaware's ratification petition. This is the Constitution, not the petition itself.
alt: The handwritten first page of the United States Constitution, headed We the People.

title: An equation in balance
reason: Equal-arm scales give a physical analogy for preserving equality on both sides of an equation. They are not a plotted algebraic model.
alt: An equal-arm beam balance and its set of small metal weights.
provenance: Auckland Museum Collections photograph from its publicly attributed collection record.

file: File:Onion cells under the light microscope.jpg
title: Onion epidermis under light microscopy
reason: Visible cell walls support comparison of cell structures. This shows plant cells, not every cell type.
alt: Elongated onion epidermal cells and their walls in a circular light-microscope field.
provenance: Kateryna Kot's 2014 photograph, uploaded for the European Science Photo Competition in 2015.

title: A parabola at full scale
institution: Parkes Observatory; photograph via Wikimedia Commons
reason: A real parabolic radio dish supplies a physical context for quadratic models. It is a two-image photographic panorama, not a function plot.
alt: The Parkes radio telescope's curved white dish and steel support beneath blue sky.
provenance: Stephen West (Diceman)'s two-photograph panorama, captured February 27, 2009.

title: Cell division in an onion root
reason: The micrograph connects cell-cycle study to observable stages of mitosis; it does not depict gene transcription.
alt: Stained onion root cells, including cells with condensed chromosomes during mitosis.
provenance: Roval312's own microscopy photograph, captured November 15, 2015.

title: Geometry made tangible
reason: Photographed physical polyhedra invite comparison of faces and spatial structure. A model supports reasoning but is not a proof.
alt: A group of real 3D-printed polyhedral models with contrasting solid and open faces.
provenance: Elizabeth Goodspeed's own May 13, 2015 photograph of models from a RISD Nature Lab workshop.

title: Logarithmic scales on a slide rule
reason: A physical application of logarithmic scales connects to comparison of function families.
alt: A yellow Pickett slide rule with logarithmic scales and a transparent cursor.
provenance: Arnold Reinhold's photograph of an instrument in his collection, dated December 16, 2015.

title: A sextant for measuring angles
reason: An angular-measurement instrument gives context to trigonometry. The unit-circle module is not a navigation lesson.
alt: A brass sextant with an arc-shaped graduated scale and optical sight.
provenance: Rama's 2018 instrument photograph; per-file CC BY-SA 3.0 France record.

title: A distribution takes shape
reason: A physical Galton box makes variation and distribution visible. Its binomial mechanism does not imply that all real data follow a normal distribution.
alt: A Galton board with rows of pegs and balls collecting into bins of different heights.

title: Matter in crystalline form
reason: An identifiable chemical substance gives context for formulas and conservation of atoms. This still photograph does not show a reaction taking place.
alt: Bright blue copper sulfate pentahydrate crystals and powder against a dark background.
provenance: W. Oelen's documented chemical specimen photograph.

title: Momentum in motion
reason: A real moving system for thinking about forces; not a free-body diagram.
alt: Suspended metal balls of a Newton's cradle, with a blurred ball recording motion.
provenance: Arigoodwoman's photograph taken at Adelson Educational Campus on November 6, 2017.

file: File:Delaware’s Tidal Wetlands (153349 - doverdelaware oli 20240903 lrg).jpg
title: Delaware's tidal wetlands
reason: A local landscape grounds ecosystem study. This natural-color satellite image is not a ground-level photograph or food-web diagram.
alt: A Landsat view of green tidal marshes, branching waterways, and land near Dover, Delaware.
provenance: NASA Earth Observatory's documented Landsat image, acquired September 3, 2024; uses USGS data.

file: File:Printing Press in Benjamin Franklin Museum.jpg
title: The tools of printing
institution: Benjamin Franklin Museum; photograph via Wikimedia Commons
reason: Real printing tools supply context for authored arguments and publishing, not a depiction of a specific lesson passage.
alt: Two hand-held ink balls with wooden handles and padded bases on a museum printing display.
provenance: Dragon Librarian's own photograph, dated January 3, 2020.

file: File:Walt Whitman, three-quarter length portrait, facing front, as a young man, dressed in rural attire for frontispiece of Leaves of Grass LCCN2004678989.jpg
title: The author as a constructed voice
institution: Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division
reason: Whitman's Leaves of Grass frontispiece provides context for authorial presentation and voice; the module is not exclusively a Whitman lesson.
alt: The young Walt Whitman in an engraved frontispiece, wearing a hat with a hand on his hip.

file: File:Fra Mauro World Map, c.1450 (1806 copy).jpg
title: A world seen from Venice
reason: A historical perspective on global knowledge. This is an 1806 reproduction, not the original map.
alt: An intricately labeled circular world map by Fra Mauro, oriented with south at the top.
provenance: W. Fraser's 1806 reproduction of Fra Mauro's fifteenth-century map, identified in the source record.

title: The legislative branch
reason: One actual institution in the separation-of-powers module; the Capitol does not stand for all three branches.
alt: The dome and east front of the United States Capitol beneath a blue sky.
provenance: Martin Falbisoner's own photograph, taken September 2, 2013.

file: File:Produce vendor at Pike Place Market (2013) - 02.jpg
title: Choices in a produce market
reason: Actual goods for sale provide context for opportunity cost; the image is not a quantitative dataset.
alt: Rows of fruit and vegetables at a vendor's stall in Pike Place Market, Seattle.
provenance: User bsmalley's own photograph, dated June 6, 2013.

file: File:A Jacquard loom showing information punchcards, National Museum of Scotland.jpg
title: Instructions made physical
institution: National Museum of Scotland; photograph via Wikimedia Commons
reason: Punch cards illustrate encoded instructions and sequence. The module teaches algorithm tracing, not operation of this loom.
alt: A chain of perforated Jacquard cards beside a loom mechanism in a museum.
provenance: Stephencdickson's own museum photograph, dated June 16, 2019.

title: Keeping account
reason: An actual adding machine provides context for arithmetic in budgets, not a financial outcome or recommendation.
alt: The keyboard and paper roller of a Continental mechanical adding machine.
provenance: Nxr-at's own photograph dated September 10, 2017.

title: A curve, a point, a direction
reason: An actual curved track motivates local slope and changing direction. It is not a measured position-time graph or a circular-motion proof.
alt: A steel roller-coaster track rising into a loop against the sky.
provenance: Jiaqian AirplaneFan's photograph, originally uploaded June 29, 2012.

title: From sampled trees to a forest
institution: USDA Forest Service, Rocky Mountain Research Station
reason: Forest Inventory and Analysis data collection is a real application of sampling. It does not show the app's fictional school survey.
alt: A forest field researcher measuring the diameter of a sample tree.
provenance: USDA Forest Service RMRS field photograph describing Chris Beebe measuring a sample tree.

file: File:Analytical balance in biochemical laboratory, Аналитичка вага.jpg
title: Measuring a chemical amount
reason: A laboratory analytical balance measures mass, the observable quantity connected to moles through molar mass.
alt: An analytical balance with a glass draft shield in a biochemical laboratory.

file: File:The Horse in Motion high res.jpg
title: Motion, frame by frame
institution: Historical photographic record via Wikimedia Commons
reason: Muybridge's timed images connect successive positions with the lesson's treatment of motion. They do not directly give velocity vectors or calibrated acceleration.
alt: A grid of Muybridge's 1878 photographs showing a horse in successive positions while galloping.
provenance: Eadweard Muybridge's 1878 photographic sequence, documented in the public-domain source record.

file: File:Hipp Chronoscope, c. 1890, view 1 - Museum of Science and Industry (Chicago) - DSC06506.JPG
title: Making response time measurable
institution: Museum of Science and Industry, Chicago
reason: A historical timing instrument gives context for operationalizing a psychological variable. The app's study examples are not results obtained with this instrument.
alt: A brass and black Hipp chronoscope, an instrument with clock dials used for precise timing.
provenance: Daderot's permitted museum photograph taken August 22, 2014, released CC0.

file: File:Tuna auction at Tsukiji Fish Market, Tokyo; 2014.jpg
title: Price discovery at auction
reason: An actual tuna auction provides a market context for supply and demand, not empirical evidence of a particular curve shift.
alt: A bidder inspecting rows of tuna before an auction at Tsukiji market in Tokyo.
provenance: Joe deSousa's documented 2014 photograph, released CC0.

file: File:Aerial photograph of the Port of Miami Container Port.jpg
title: Production, trade, and scale
reason: Real container trade gives macroeconomic context. A port photograph does not measure GDP, inflation, or unemployment.
alt: An aerial photograph of container stacks, cranes, and ships at the Port of Miami.
provenance: James R. Tourtellotte's U.S. Customs and Border Protection photograph.

file: File:Jacob Riis - Bohemian Cigarmakers at Work in their Tenement.jpg
title: Work, housing, and institutions
reason: Riis's historical photograph connects individual working lives with housing and economic structures. It is one photographer's situated record, not a representative sample.
alt: Workers making cigars at tables inside a nineteenth-century tenement.
provenance: Jacob Riis's nineteenth-century documentary photograph, reproduced from its historical collection.

file: File:Delaware Legislative Hall Dover DSC 3463 ad.JPG
title: Government at the state level
reason: Delaware's actual Legislative Hall connects federalism with a state institution. It does not imply affiliation or official endorsement.
alt: Delaware Legislative Hall in Dover, a red-brick building with white columns and a cupola.
provenance: Adavyd's own architectural photograph of Legislative Hall in Dover.

title: An argument in public
reason: An actual abolitionist newspaper supplies context for purpose, audience, and public argument. This is not a passage quoted in the module.
alt: The masthead and narrow text columns of The North Star newspaper, June 2, 1848.
provenance: Frederick Douglass's North Star, June 2, 1848; Library of Congress scan recorded on Commons since 2009.

file: File:Onion peel under a microscope(hypertensive solution).jpg
title: Cells in a hypertonic solution
reason: The documented onion-cell plasmolysis image connects to osmosis. It is a different specimen and experiment from the module's model data.
alt: Onion cells with cell contents drawn away from their walls, seen in a circular microscope field.
provenance: Kristina Tsimlyakowa's microscope photograph taken December 6, 2016.

file: File:Coloured flames of methanol solutions of metal salts and compounds.jpg
title: Elements leave an optical signature
reason: Real flame colors provide context for electronic energy levels. They do not directly measure atomic radius or establish the module's periodic-trend explanation.
alt: A row of differently colored flames from metal compounds burning on cotton wool.
provenance: Hegelrast's documented chemical demonstration photographed June 25, 2019. Context image, not instructions to reproduce it.

title: At the base of a food web
reason: Actual diatoms ground the idea of primary producers in an ecosystem; the image does not measure trophic efficiency or show the model fertilizer experiment.
alt: Assorted intricately shaped diatoms observed through a microscope.
provenance: Professor Gordon T. Taylor's 1983 micrograph of diatoms living between annual sea-ice crystals in Antarctica.

title: A mathematical instrument
reason: Leibniz's stepped reckoner provides historical context for mathematical work by a co-developer of calculus. It performs arithmetic, not the limit calculations in this lesson.
alt: The brass stepped-drum mechanism of Leibniz's mechanical calculating machine.
provenance: User Kolossos's photograph of the documented stepped reckoner; source record predates contemporary generative imagery.

title: State stored in wire and ferrite
reason: A real memory array gives context for program state during loop tracing. It is not a photograph of Java code or the lesson's algorithm.
alt: A close-up of tiny magnetic rings threaded by a dense grid of copper wires.
provenance: Jud McCranie (Bubba73)'s close-up photograph taken April 22, 2015.

title: Words shaped for an audience
reason: Lincoln's handwritten address provides a real example of authored rhetoric. It is not the fictional school-board passage used in the module.
alt: Abraham Lincoln's handwritten Bliss copy of the Gettysburg Address.
provenance: Abraham Lincoln's final draft of the address, written in March 1864, as documented by its archival source.
